name: @ai-engineering-playbook/cli
description: Cross-platform governance CLI for the AI Engineering Playbook

scripts.sync-schemas: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const path = require('path'); const src = path.resolve('../../schemas'); if (fs.existsSync(src)) { fs.copyFileSync(path.join(src, 'project-manifest.schema.json'), 'src/schemas/project-manifest.schema.json'); fs.copyFileSync(path.join(src, 'project-state.schema.json'), 'src/schemas/project-state.schema.json'); }"
scripts.build: npm run sync-schemas && tsc && node -e "const fs = require('fs'); fs.cpSync('src/schemas', 'dist/src/schemas', {recursive: true});"
